  \caption[Policy-collapse matrix]{The share of self-play plays taken by the single most-played action at each episode-step position, over training. This is the policy-collapse matrix: a share approaching one means the agent plays one fixed byte at that position regardless of state. Read together with \cref{fig:structural-rate}, it distinguishes a run that learned the grammar from one that found a single high-reward token. Colour encodes share of the most-played action.}
